Name: Sebastian HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Pelican Town’s favorite basement dweller got a glow-up. 🖤
[b]Sebastian HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] gives Seb a semi-realistic makeover with long, tousled black hair, blue-violet eyes, a defined jawline, and broader shoulders. Still broody. Still wearing that hoodie. Just making it significantly harder to romance anyone else.
Includes everyday and beach portraits, because the Sebastian obsession doesn’t take vacations.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Portraiture[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract this portrait pack.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Create a folder named[/color]

[code]Hemptress Sebastian[/code][color=#D4D4D8]inside:[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the portrait PNGs directly inside that folder. Make sure they’re named[/color]

[code]Sebastian.png[/code][color=#D4D4D8]and[/color]

[code]Sebastian_IslandSouth.png[/code][color=#D4D4D8].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Talk to Sebastian and press [b]P[/b] while his dialogue box is open to cycle through portrait packs until mine appears.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Your everyday portrait should be located at:[/color]

[code]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Hemptress Sebastian/Sebastian.png[/code]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Detailed, semi-realistic HD portraits.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Long black hair and striking blue-violet eyes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A broader, more masculine look.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multiple expressions, from broody side-eye to that rare little smile.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Matching everyday hoodie and beach portraits.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enough pretty-boy angst to derail your farming plans.[/color]



[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Portraiture by Platonymous[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Use versions compatible with your game. Current Portraiture versions do [b]not[/b] require PyTK.[/color]
